verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a managed company-incorporation service. Its core product consists of Stripe acting on the user's behalf: filing with Delaware and the IRS, providing a registered agent, issuing shares and filing 83(b) elections. Self-hosting that service is a category error rather than a missing feature, and nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable component exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
